title: Macron visits India to deepen defence ties and AI cooperation
summary: French President Emmanuel Macron arrives in India on Tuesday for a three-day visit focused on artificial intelligence cooperation, defence deals and strengthening strategic ties, with discussions expected on a potential multibillion-dollar Rafale fighter jet agreement.
contentText: French President Emmanuel Macron on Tuesday praised the "remarkable acceleration" of France's ties with India in response to the "changing international order". Macron met with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi in Mumbai at the start of a three-day visit focused on artificial intelligence cooperation and defence deals, including a potential multibillion-dollar Rafale fighter jet agreement.
